body.text: All updates below are for Clash Arena.

texts: Added support for the Battle Royale mode. This mode supports significantly more players and has a few adjustments to support them. The server may experience instability if too many players join, so the maximum number of players may be adjusted in the future.
Added keyword modifiers. Solemn Lament Yi Sang and Blade Lineage Meursault should now get additional keywords if their corresponding E.G.O are also drafted.
Fixed the rank numbering and highlighted the player on the end game results screen.
Fixed an issue where E.G.O skill details stopped appearing during drafting.
